speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis (Sengkang)
text: The first is, under the NIRC, I just wanted to understand if it is both the expected real rate of return that is estimated and is it also that of the net asset base.

speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis (Sengkang)
text: The second is, in terms of the 2021 numbers, as I understand, there would be the similar 50% that will be taken in 2021 as with 2016 to 2020.

speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis (Sengkang)
text: In terms of the increase in the absolute NIRC contribution, may I ask the Minister what would that increase be attributable to?

speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis (Sengkang)
text: Would it be based on the higher rates of return or higher net asset base?
